title: 第十六章暴富与吞金兽
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡越翻，越觉得这废丹洞亲切。

    亲切得有点想给马得水烧柱香。

    要不是那肥猪为了害他，把整座废丹洞丢给他一个人，他哪有机会独吞这一批新废丹？

    当然，香就算了。

    回头见面，给他留个全尸，已经很讲人情。

    傍晚前，最后一袋废丹被叶凡倒空。

    他坐在石台边，背靠洞壁，胸膛起伏了几下。

    累。

    不是毒瘴伤身，是活太多。

    一天之内，把整座废丹山翻了个底朝天，连地火坑旁边的角落都没漏。

    换成以前那个九十岁老头，翻两袋就该躺下等埋。

    现在他只是手腕酸。

    叶凡看着面前的成果。

    五个袋子。

    全是残存药力的废丹。

    其中锻体废丹最多，壮骨丹、回灵丹、避瘴丹也有不少。

    凝气废丹最少，却也挑出了一小袋。

    这批货若拿去黑市，光按废丹卖都能换点灵石。

    可在叶凡眼里，卖废丹那叫糟践。

    他拍了拍麻袋，听见里面丹丸碰撞，心里总算舒服了点。

    “还行。”

    他擦掉额头汗水。

    “外门疯狗要是今晚来，我就把这五袋丹药塞他嘴里，让他也富贵一回。”

    歇了没多久，叶凡又站起来。

    他没把这些废丹全搬回屋。

    太显眼。

    破屋门都快掉了，万一有人摸上来，一眼看见五大袋丹药，那不是请人抢劫吗？

    他在洞内找了个石缝，把两袋暂时藏进去，用碎石和废渣盖住。

    剩下三袋扛回破屋。

    天已经黑了。

    废阁外风声很低，山道那边没动静。

    叶凡进屋后，先把破门板重新顶上，又搬了块石头压住门脚。

    顶不顶用另说，多少给自己一点心理安慰。

    屋里还是那副穷酸样。

    塌床，碎碗，烂桌。

    唯一值钱的，是叶凡胸口那只赤金小炉。

    他把三袋废丹放在地上，活动了一下肩膀，随后取下小炉，摆在桌上。

    “开饭。”

    小炉没反应。

    叶凡抓起三颗废锻体丹丢进去。

    炉身亮起红光。

    这光一出，破屋里那点寒酸立马变了味。

    烂桌被照红，断床被照红，墙上裂缝也被照红。

    药渣味开始散去，取而代之的是丹香。

    三颗废丹没了。

    一颗圆润的一星锻体丹滚出来。

    叶凡接住，放在左边。

    然后继续。

    废丹一把把减少，桌上的丹药一颗颗增多。

    叶凡动作很快。

    他不再像刚得到合成炉时那样每一颗都拿起来闻半天，现在见得多了，眼界也被喂刁了。
content_en:
The more Ye Fan flipped through it, the more friendly he felt about this waste pill cave.

    He was so kind that he almost wanted to burn incense sticks for Ma Deshui.

    If the fat pig hadn't left the entire Waste Pill Cave to him alone in order to harm him, how would he have had the chance to swallow this new batch of Waste Pills?

    Of course, forget about the fragrance.

    When we meet later, leaving his body intact is already very humane.

    Before evening, the last bag of waste pills was emptied by Ye Fan.

    He sat on the edge of the stone platform, leaning against the cave wall, and his chest heaved a few times.

    tired.

    It's not that the poisonous miasma hurts the body, it's that we live too much.

    In one day, the entire Waste Dan Mountain was turned upside down, even the corners next to the fire pit were not leaked.

    If it were the ninety-year-old man from before, he would lie down and wait for burial after digging through two bags.

    Now he just has a sore wrist.

    Ye Fan looked at the results in front of him.

    Five bags.

    They are all useless elixirs with remaining medicinal power.

    Among them, there are the most useless body-building elixirs, and there are also many bone-strengthening elixirs, spirit-restoring elixirs, and miasma-avoiding elixirs.

    The Qi Condensation Waste Pill was the least, but he also picked out a small bag.

    If this batch of goods were taken to the black market, they could be exchanged for some spiritual stones just by selling them as waste elixirs.

    But in Ye Fan's eyes, selling waste elixirs is called waste.

    He patted the sack and heard the collision of the pills inside, which finally made him feel better.

    "It's okay."

    He wiped the sweat from his brow.

    "If the mad dog from the outer sect comes tonight, I will stuff these five bags of elixirs into his mouth and make him rich again."

    Not long after resting, Ye Fan stood up again.

    He didn't move all the waste elixirs back to the house.

    Too conspicuous.

    The door of the broken house is almost falling off. If someone comes up and sees five big bags of pills, wouldn't they ask someone to rob it?

    He found a crevice in the rocks, temporarily hid the two bags inside, and covered them with gravel and debris.

    The remaining three bags were carried back to the shabby house.

    It was already dark.

    The wind noise outside the abandoned pavilion was very low, and there was no movement on the mountain road.

    After Ye Fan entered the house, he first put the broken door panel back up, and then moved a stone to hold down the door foot.

    Whether it is worth it or not is another matter, but give yourself some psychological comfort.

    The house still looked so poor.

    Collapsed bed, broken bowls, broken table.

    The only valuable thing was the small red gold furnace on Ye Fan's chest.

    He placed three bags of waste pills on the ground, moved his shoulders, then took off the small stove and placed it on the table.

    "Let's eat."

    The stove didn't respond.

    Ye Fan grabbed three waste body forging pills and threw them in.

    The furnace body lights up red.

    As soon as the light came out, the shabby atmosphere in the dilapidated house immediately changed.

    The broken table was illuminated red, the broken bed was illuminated red, and the cracks in the wall were illuminated red.

    The smell of medicinal residue began to dissipate, replaced by the fragrance of red pepper.

    The three waste elixirs are gone.

    A round one-star body-building pill rolled out.

    Ye Fan caught it and placed it on the left.

    Then continue.

    The number of useless elixirs decreased one by one, and the number of elixirs on the table increased one by one.

    Ye Fan moved quickly.

    He no longer picked up each one and smelled it for a long time like he did when he first got the synthesis furnace. Now he had seen more, and his vision was also spoiled.
title_en: Chapter 16: Get rich and the gold-eating beast
